description: This file contains common functions, exception classes, and utilities used for WebSocket handshake processing, including validation, parsing, and error handling.

classes.name: AbortedByUserException
classes.description: Exception for aborting a WebSocket connection intentionally.

classes.name: HandshakeException
classes.description: Exception raised during errors in WebSocket handshake processing.

classes.name: VersionException
classes.description: Exception raised when client request version does not match server support.

methods.name: get_default_port
methods.description: Returns default WebSocket port based on security (secure or not).

methods.name: parse_host_header
methods.description: Parses the Host header to extract hostname and port.

methods.name: format_header
methods.description: Formats a header name and value into a string.

methods.name: get_mandatory_header
methods.description: Retrieves a required header value from the request.

methods.name: validate_mandatory_header
methods.description: Validates that a header matches an expected value.

methods.name: check_request_line
methods.description: Checks that the request method and protocol are correct for WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: parse_token_list
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of tokens from a header value.
